protocol.source: sql/sql_prepare.cc in the pinned MySQL tags

compound.construction: A balanced UNION ALL with 64 SELECT occurrences and 1024 native cast markers per occurrence
compound.actual: Published complete IR followed by native prepared-statement error 1390.

with.construction: 63 ordinary WITH definitions and a SELECT body, each with 1024 native cast markers
with.actual: Published complete IR followed by native prepared-statement error 1390.

counterexample.positive: Replace the last marker with the signed literal 11. Both published SQL strings prepare with exactly 65535 parameters and 1024 result fields.

constructors.Select: Count a marker once per contiguous local occurrence. Derived join inputs use the closed marker-free role. Named and anonymous projected occurrences count equally.
constructors.Compound: Add the counts of the expanded left and right operands before publication. A shared PHP arm contributes independently at each occurrence.
constructors.LocalProjection: Use the defining query's count. Repeating a field in the consumer contributes zero occurrences.
constructors.WithProjection: Add every definition in the lexical prefix and the final body. Unused definitions are printed and contribute their full counts. Nested WITH and local definitions contribute their recursive counts.
constructors.WithRead: A resolved slot read contributes no independent marker. Its definition has already contributed in the enclosing prefix.

conditions: Both the set and WITH constructors reject the first aggregate count greater than 65535. Where a form and width otherwise belong to the checked profile, this condition permits every count through 65535. Each admitted parameter produces exactly one question-mark token in native SQL. Counting derives from the typed graph and uses the same SQL occurrence boundaries as rendering.
observations: Actual PHP statement role, resolved checked occurrences and exact covered construction boundary.
Native prepare parameter count and result field count at adjacent input counts. Echo and compare native SQL digests.
At small composition sizes also exercise named and anonymous marker order, values, native types and result names through the independently checked named marker domain.

finite.additional: Legacy supported compositions cannot reach 65535 within their checked depth and width. Retain complete small legacy coverage from the bound parameter and named marker domains.
finite.recovery: Recover the two axes from the externally scheduled graph, accepted render protocol response or exact rejection, and the independently rendered native adjacency reference. Require every coordinate exactly once.

faults: Remove the ordinary WITH marker limit.
Omit marker counts from unused definitions.
Replace expanded compound counts with one count per shared object.
Count the WITH marker again when a local binding is read.

obligations.Q01: Verify the upper bound through the closed public composition routes and precise negative boundary samples.
obligations.Q02: Verify the adjacent valid counts in the unchanged composition domain.
obligations.Q03: Check the finite-graph count by induction over the structural cases and confirm expansions in the actual PHP renderer and selected native prepare protocol.
obligations.Q04: Compare native prepared parameter and result arity for the boundary cases. Use the independently observed typed row and binding cases for ordering and values.
obligations.Q05: Pin the source forms that derive the count, enforce the boundary and emit a single marker per stored occurrence. Connect native and installed observations to the exact release bytes.

remainingBaseline: The supported local projection width has additional gaps independent of the statement-wide protocol limit. A direct 1025-marker top-level SELECT prepares on 8.0.44 and 8.2.0 but is refused by the candidate's local position bound. Larger native projection and component width obligations stay open.
